Peso Pluma's birth name is **Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija**.

Claims and support:

- His birth name is Hassan Emilio Kabande Laija. Wikipedia's article gives this name, and the search results list the same name: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma
- He was born on 15 June 1999 in Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma
- Some sites say Guadalajara instead of Zapopan. Zapopan is part of the Guadalajara metropolitan area, so this is probably a difference in how the place is described, but I didn't verify that. Sources: https://www.famousbirthdays.com/people/peso-pluma.html and https://www.legit.ng/ask-legit/biographies/1560619-peso-plumas-height-age-real-parents-nationality/
- He is a Mexican singer-songwriter known for regional Mexican music and corridos tumbados. This came from the search summary, not from a page I read in full. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peso_Pluma

Limits: I only read the first 100,000 characters of the roughly 194,000-character Wikipedia page, and the name and birth details were in that part. I didn't open the other biography sites, so I'm relying on their search snippets for the Guadalajara claim.
